definition: אַכַּד proper name, of a location Akkad Gen 10:10 וַתְּהִי רֵאשִׁית וְכַלְנֶה בְּאֶרֶץ שִׁנְעָֽר׃ ׳ מַמְלַכְתּוֺ בָּבֶל וְאֶרֶח וְא ; name of a city in Northern (?) Babylonia; = Babylonian Akkadi, mostly name of land or district, but also of city, see Hilpr Freibrief Neb. I, col. ii, 1. 50 ; location uncertain; on possible identification or confusion with Agade ( A gate, A gane ? ), city of Sargon I, compare Dl Pa 198 & K 19 f. COT Gen 10:10 Tiele Geschichte i. 76 f . אַכְזָב , אַכְזִיב see כזב . אַכְזָר , אַכְזָרִי , אַכְזְרִיּוּת see כזר .
